method: Read all 253 Simplified source units and Traditional draft units side by side, in order, independently of the CoreFoundation conversion step. Then applied contextual orthographic corrections and checked every altered unit, title, deck and index introduction.
semantic_findings: Complete one-to-one coverage with source negation, qualifiers, causal claims, rhetorical questions, examples, pronouns and historical qualifications preserved. No condensation or substantive reinterpretation added. All headings and paragraphs were read, not sampled.
historical_corrections_checked: Rhineland counterfactual is possible retreat, not assured prevention of all later catastrophe (2:3).
German/Japanese postwar changes both protracted and uneven (3:24).
Bengal famine is multicausal, with colonial wartime policy and failed relief aggravating it (3:28).
Dresden challenge is authorial questioning rather than an attributed Goering courtroom quotation; Nazi responsibility is not diminished (4:14).
1949 to August 1961 migration is about 2.7 million to West Germany and West Berlin (5:3).
Fukuyama 1989 ideological endpoint distinguished from end of events/conflicts and simplified triumphalism, with dependent transitions preserved (5:32,33,37,39).

Also preserved earlier approved carriage/armistice/fire, reparations date and Article 231, coerced destruction of Weimar democracy, Czechoslovakia partition, rail passenger/distance fees, Ota June 6 telegram, Dresden death range, Nuremberg defendants and prehistory, UDHR committees/non-treaty/legal effects, Welch and censure, Berlin Wall protest prehistory qualifications.
Follow-up source correction: Korematsu arrest in San Leandro, rendered 聖萊安德羅 (3:27); full paragraph re-read against updated source.
contextual_character_checks: Locative 里 changed to 裡; retained 里 in 墨索里尼, 里根, and 里程.
Fixed converter word-boundary error 蘇聯繫統 to 蘇聯系統 in 5:19 and 5:27.
Fixed aspect-marker 說明瞭/證明瞭 to 說明了/證明了.
Fixed 精准, 反復, 抵御, 幸存; normalized 沈下去, 啓動 and 不可想象.
后/後, 發/髮, 克/剋 and 干/乾 reviewed contextually: chronology uses 後, 發 describes issuing/developing, names/currency/tanks/攻克 retain 克, 乾脆 and 干預 are appropriate. No hair sense requires 髮.
Retained source regional vocabulary and proper-name transliterations rather than silently imposing Taiwan lexical localization.
Traditional index 威瑪 normalized to 魏瑪 to match all approved essay sources. This is a proper-name consistency edit, not an approved-source rewrite.
automated_checks: All frozen source file SHA-256 values match source-finalization.json.
Every source content hash recomputed from canonical title/body JSON and matches source_sha256; each translation matches that hash.
Renderer validate passes for all five files.
Body counts 47/51/45/56/54 = 253. HTML tag sequences and numeric sequences match source.
He/she/it pronoun counts match each paired unit; no TODO/TBD/VERIFY/replacement-character placeholders.

changes.before: 1918年11月，貢比涅森林，在一節火車車廂里，德國代表簽下了停戰協定。二十二年後，希特勒命人把同一節車廂搬回原來的位置，讓法國代表在那裡簽下停戰協定。車廂隨後被運到柏林展出，後來又轉移到圖林根，1945年毀於火災。

changes.before: 水門事件導致了尼克松辭職，一個在任總統居然被自己國家的司法和媒體系統逼退。這在蘇聯是不可想象的，當然不是因為蘇聯領導人不會犯錯，而是因為蘇聯繫統中沒有任何力量可以追究領導人的錯誤。

changes.before: 為什麼？因為到了1989年，蘇聯模式的正當性已經是一個空殼了。蘇聯繫統的正當性建立在一個時間性的承諾上：歷史正在走向共產主義，一切犧牲都是為了那個終點。但到了八十年代，沒有人再相信這個承諾了——包括系統內部的大多數人。他們繼續按照系統的要求行事，不是因為相信，而是因為慣性。

changes.before: 冷戰的結束證明瞭一件事：一個完全封閉的系統——沒有信息多元性，沒有權力制衡，沒有反饋迴路——最終會因為自身的剛性而碎裂。不管它的工業能力多強、軍事力量多大、意識形態多完整，如果它不能識別和修復自己的錯誤，它就在倒計時。
